title.value: The University of Tokyo Research Internship Program
title.evidence_quote: The University of Tokyo Research Internship Program

institution.name: School of Science, The University of Tokyo

qualifications: Enrolled in, and expected to return to, a bachelor's degree programme at a university outside Japan
Studying a natural science or related field
Able to commit full-time to all six consecutive weeks
English test scores required if English is not the first language (exemption for 8 years of continuous English-medium education)
description_short: UTRIP is a six-week research internship at the University of Tokyo School of Science, 23 June to 3 August 2027, for undergraduates in natural sciences at universities outside Japan. Applications run 12 November to 25 December 2026, 17:00 JST.

deadline.evidence_quote: The application period is from November 12, 2026 to December 25, 2026

compensation.value: GSS-UTRIP Scholarship including free housing and a stipend (except FUTI Award recipients)
compensation.evidence_quote: all participants except for those receiving the FUTI Award will receive the GSS-UTRIP Scholarship, which includes free housing and a stipend
